verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing, metering and entitlements platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Autumn publishes its own MCP server for AI assistants to connect to. That is server-side and cannot be credited to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
